purpose: Data roles and the current AJAE causal-window research protocol

task.name: AJAE
task.input: One current LiDAR scan and as many as four already observed scans from the same sequence
task.output: One anomaly score for every real return in the current scan; the frozen STU query assignment is retained only for the official object-level evaluation

window_startup_rule.available_history_only: At a sequence boundary, use only causal scans that already exist; never borrow a scan from another sequence or the future.
window_startup_rule.complete_window_reason: A five-scan causal window generally starts at current frame 4. Only normal 201 starts at current frame 8 because its source frames 0 through 3 contain exact internal duplicates and must not appear as current input or history.

source_duplicate_audit.frame_0: slots [0:131072], [131072:262144], and [262144:393216] are byte-identical in both scan and label files
source_duplicate_audit.frame_1: slots [0:131072], [131072:262144], and [262144:393216] are byte-identical in both scan and label files
source_duplicate_audit.frame_2: slots [29184:160256] and [160256:291328] are byte-identical in both scan and label files
source_duplicate_audit.frame_3: slots [0:131072] and [131072:262144] are byte-identical in both scan and label files
source_duplicate_audit.scope: The inherited schema-27 64-window validation subset starts at current frame 9 and is unaffected. Future complete-window threshold estimation and schema-28 experiments must exclude these source frames from both current input and history.

normal_validation.counterfactual_generation: Use fixed generator seeds that are distinct from every normal-206 training seed.

public_anomaly_validation.sequence_125_rule: Process sequence 125 with the same reader, model, threshold, instance construction, and metrics as every other public validation sequence.

label_semantics.packed_label: The lower 16 bits are raw semantic identity and the upper 16 bits are instance identity.
label_semantics.normal_semantic_training: Map raw normal-sequence semantics directly to the STU head targets: known classes use indices 0 through 18 and ignored semantics use 255.
label_semantics.normal_instance_training: Use the complete raw semantic and instance identity to retain the official STU instance organization on normal data.

binary_anomaly_training.synthetic_members: anomaly even when the generated return replaces a zero or normal source slot
binary_anomaly_training.strict_zero_coordinate_slots: exclude unless counterfactual rendering creates a nonzero synthetic return on that ray
binary_anomaly_training.basis: The binary objective follows the public anomaly task and is independent of the 19-class STU semantic-head ignore map.

label_semantics.strict_zero_coordinate_slots: For an unmodified real scan, keep every file slot for output restoration and assign score zero to a slot whose raw x, y, and z are all exactly zero. During counterfactual rendering, the same physical ray may become a nonzero synthetic return when it intersects the inserted surface.

pretrained_model.checkpoint_identity: STU deep-ensemble member 1 with reported normal panoptic quality 59.6
pretrained_model.initialization_role: The official single-scan weights initialize the shared spatial representation and current-frame branch; they do not define the final temporal computation.

counterfactual_anomalies.object_construction: Insert one connected procedural object made from two intersecting homothetic ellipsoidal surfaces with ground contact, yaw, a persistent world identity, and one planar trajectory.
counterfactual_anomalies.history_ablation: All history-length conditions use the same rendered object, physical trajectory, current scan, and already existing historical returns; only the number of readable causal scans changes.

ray_rendering.unit: one physical LiDAR ray in one source scan
ray_rendering.nearest_return_rule: Compare the nearest original-scene intersection with the nearest synthetic-surface intersection and retain the nearer return.
ray_rendering.synthetic_front: Emit one anomaly return and occlude the original return only when the synthetic surface is strictly more than 0.05 m nearer, i.e. d_synthetic+0.05<d_original.
ray_rendering.original_front: Keep the original return and its normal or ignore label.
ray_rendering.no_intersection: Emit no return only when neither the recorded scene nor the synthetic surface supplies a return.

intensity_sampling.rule: For every synthetic return, sample one intensity from the matching normal-206 stratum. If that exact incidence stratum is empty, pool incidence strata for the same range and beam; if that pool is empty, pool all beams and incidence strata in the same range bin.
intensity_sampling.verified_global_evidence: The frozen calibration contains exactly the multiset of all 56,196,767 nonzero-coordinate normal-206 intensity float32 bit patterns.
intensity_sampling.provenance_limit: The retained calibration artifact does not preserve the generator, source-frame membership, or per-point range-beam-incidence assignment that created its 2,280 strata; the global multiset identity does not prove the stratum assignments.

counterfactual_anomalies.current_visibility_rule: A frozen trajectory plan is valid only when the rendered current scan contains at least one synthetic return; the renderer must reproduce the plan's stored current-return count exactly.
counterfactual_anomalies.ineligible_ground_rule: Skip a window whose current scan has no eligible ground-contact anchor; do not fabricate an object and do not abort the remaining run.
counterfactual_anomalies.oracle_truth_restriction: Synthetic identity and trajectory may construct the Clean Select upper bound, supply truth-motion candidates to the two Proposal-only arms, and supervise same-object probability mass or null. They must never enter q, k, v, temporal context, the anomaly classifier, a gate, a candidate-type embedding, or a slot-specific parameter.
counterfactual_anomalies.validation_generation: Apply the same generator to normal 201 with fixed seeds distinct from all training seeds.

model.name: current-anchored factorized causal window encoder
model.spatial_initialization: Apply one frozen, shared STU spatial encoder to every available scan and preserve the official current-frame representation.
model.current_anchor: Compute the current point feature and current anomaly logit once, then let history contribute only an additive bounded correction.

history_correspondence.clean_select: At each scale and frame age, construct exactly one truth-selected h_mix real candidate from the current synthetic fraction and valid static/object history, plus one null candidate. Missing mass stays zero, and h_mix is never duplicated.
history_correspondence.proposal_oracle_candidates: At every sparse query, present static-aligned and truth-motion-aligned evidence as exchangeable real hypotheses plus null, with shared candidate parameters inside each independent Proposal arm and no candidate-type embedding.
history_correspondence.truth_use: Generator truth may construct Clean Select, provide the truth-motion proposal, and define same-object or null supervision; it never enters q, k, v, temporal context, the anomaly classifier, a learned gate, or candidate-slot identity.

explicit_null.rule: Append one learned-score, zero-value null candidate independently at every temporal scale and every available history age.

model.factorized_temporal_update: At p16, p8, and p4, score low-dimensional current/history features with shared candidate parameters within one arm, normalize over all real and per-age null candidates in the requested causal window for temporal aggregation, and propagate the resulting coarse-to-fine residual to current points. Direct correspondence supervision reuses the same logits but normalizes independently within each history age; it adds no scoring parameters or classifier input.
model.temporal_output: For current point i, use z_win_i=z_cur_i+delta_i with delta_i=4*tanh(h_temporal(f_cur_i,h_hist_i)); zero real-history support gives delta_i=0 by construction.
model.prediction: Apply sigmoid to the corrected current-point logit and return scores only for real returns in the current scan.

stage_a.purpose: Fit the current-frame point anomaly baseline while the STU representation remains fixed.
stage_a.state_rule: Use the final preregistered pass state; do not select a pass after validation.

stage_b.purpose: With one frozen current branch and identical temporal initialization, separate a leakage-controlled Clean Select upper bound from Proposal-only candidate selection with and without direct correspondence supervision.

independent_arms.clean_select: classification objective only; one truth-selected real candidate plus null per age
independent_arms.proposal_direct: Proposal-only classification plus direct same-object probability-mass and null supervision

stage_b.state_isolation: All three arms start from the same frozen stage-A current head and identical temporal initialization, then use independent temporal parameters, optimizers, and random states. Proposal arms receive no Clean Select gradient.
stage_b.magnitude_control: L_mag is class-balanced SmoothL1(delta_i,0) with beta=1.0.
stage_b.direct_match: L_match=-sum_(i,k) r_i*log(sum_{j in P_(i,k)} a_direct_(i,j,k))/sum_(i,k) r_i over generated-object query-age pairs with at least one same-object candidate; P_(i,k) may contain both static and truth-motion candidates.
stage_b.direct_null: L_null=-sum_(i,k) r_i*log(a_direct_(i,null,k))/sum_(i,k) r_i over generated-object query-age pairs with no same-object candidate but at least one valid competing real candidate. When every real candidate is invalid, null is structurally certain and the zero-gradient pair is reported but excluded from the loss denominator.
stage_b.direct_weights: proposal_direct uses L_class+1.0*(L_match+L_null), with p16, p8, and p4 weighted equally; the other arms do not use direct correspondence loss.
stage_b.state_rule: Use the final preregistered pass state; do not select a pass after validation.

gradient_audit.ratio_gate: For temporal parameters, median_window ||grad L_direct||_2/||grad L_class||_2 must be in [0.1,10], and each p16/p8/p4 median must not exceed 20; lambda_dir remains 1.0.
gradient_audit.rule: After stage A and before temporal training, use independent Proposal-only forwards and torch.autograd.grad to measure the joint classification and direct-supervision gradients on eight frozen windows without constructing an optimizer or changing formal parameters. Separately verify L_match and learnable L_null reach the p16, p8, and p4 scorers. Candidate-order invariance is checked both at the untouched temporal initialization and on an independently copied, deterministically perturbed nonzero temporal state; every audit path restores formal parameters, RNG, mode, requires_grad flags, and gradient buffers in finally.

completed_schema27_oracle_experiment.boundary: Used duplicated Select evidence slots and one jointly updated Select/Proposal temporal state; it supports history value under truth correspondence but is not evidence for Clean Select, Proposal-only training, direct supervision, or a learned matcher.

mechanism_experiment.order: Run the schema-28 deconfounded 24/16 screen first. Only a preregistered pass permits a separately initialized and newly frozen 96/64 confirmation; neither is formal ten-epoch training.
mechanism_experiment.public_anomaly_access: Do not access public anomaly validation until the method is frozen after the normal-sequence mechanism work.

future_matcher.activation_rule: Develop a learned p16-to-p8-to-p4 candidate generator only after proposal_direct passes the deconfounded 24/16 screen, a newly frozen independent 96/64 confirmation also passes, and normal-motion safety remains acceptable.
future_matcher.direct_supervision: For every history age, supervise probability mass on same-object historical candidates or the explicit null when no same-object return is visible; structural all-real-invalid cases are reported separately from learnable null competitions.
future_matcher.truth_motion_after_activation: The learned candidate generator must not receive generator-truth displacement at inference or as a candidate proposal.

inference.history: Use the current scan and up to four already observed scans from the same sequence.
inference.online_cache: Cache immutable frozen STU features for prior scans within a sequence and encode only the newly arrived scan.
inference.cache_reset: Clear all cached features at every sequence boundary.
inference.output_restoration: Write current-frame scores and frozen STU query identities back to the original file slots; strict zero-coordinate slots receive score and identity zero.

normal_alarm_threshold.rule: Sort valid normal-point scores and use the ceil((1-0.001)*n)-th one-based order statistic as the threshold; a point is alarmed when its score is strictly greater than the threshold.

anomaly_instances.query_assignment: Assign every alarmed point to its highest-probability non-background frozen STU query.

evaluation.public_evaluation: After method freeze, pool the official valid points and anomaly instances from all 19 public validation sequences, including sequence 125.
evaluation.hidden_test: After method freeze, export one current-frame anomaly score for every original test-file slot in the official submission format.

baseline.comparison: Run the official NDP model independently under the same STU point and object evaluation definitions.
